**Wed 2026-11-25**
- 08:30 ET — Q3 GDP 2nd estimate + Oct PCE/Core PCE + initial claims + durable goods — growth vs inflation vs Fed
- 14:00 ET — Beige Book — regional activity color

**Thu 2026-11-26**
- Markets closed (Thanksgiving) — no major prints

**Fri 2026-11-27** (early close 1:00 ET)
- no major prints

## Stock / catalysts — next 30 days
**Window end-Nov 2026** — ASTS — BlueBird 17-19 expected to ship for Blue Origin launch early Q1 2027 — window — company Q3 update (Nov 9/12)
**NET Q4 2026** — ASTS — BlueBird 14-16 (at Cape) SpaceX launch (trackers list ~30-31 Dec placeholder; awaiting confirmation) — window — company / launch trackers
**End-2026** — ASTS — initial intermittent US/key-market service target — window — company
**Mid-Dec 2026** — TMC — NOAA final determination on USA-A application certification (not commercial permit) — window — TMC Nov 12 update / Nov 3 letter
ASTS: no single-day dated earnings/AGM/hearings/spectrum items in 30d.
TMC: no earnings/AGM in 30d; $11.50 public/private warrants expired unexercised Sept 9 2026.
No dated geo/policy meetings with critical minerals/spectrum/deep-sea on published agenda in window.

## Insiders — recently reported (ASTS, TMC)
ASTS: Nov 19 Form 4 — CTO Huiwen Yao exercised 40,000 AST LLC Incentive Equity Options at $0.0641, acquiring 40,000 Class A shares (post-transaction direct holding ~74,750). Exercise-and-hold, not open-market purchase. No open-market buys/sells or new 10b5-1 in last 14d.
TMC: no Form 4/144 in last 14d.

## Rates and bonds
10y ~4.94-5.04% (Fri close ~4.94-5.04, down ~10 bp on day), 2y ~4.65-4.76% (down ~11 bp), 10y–2y ~+28-30 bp (not inverted). 5y TIPS real ~2.53%, 5y breakeven ~2.18%, 10y breakeven ~2.15%. 5y5y forward ~2.12% (sourceable). Growth fears dominate after equity rout; inflation expectations anchored; Fed path still data-dependent into Dec 8-9 meeting (markets price further hike risk).

## USD/JPY
Spot ~158.5-159.1 (overnight modestly firmer / range-bound). Short trend stable near recent highs; no fresh intervention chatter; US yield pullback limits upside for now.

## Equities tape
SPX closed Fri 6,910.39 (−3.70%, ~−11.6% from Oct ATH ~7,819; in correction), NDX/QQQ heavier (Nasdaq Comp −5.3%), IWM/small-caps lagged. Breadth weak (proxy: broad selling, equal-weight underperformed). VIX closed ~35.9 (elevated, highest since March). Overnight futures not material in available data.

## Names / themes only if material overnight
No material overnight headlines, filings, or outsized moves for ASTS, TMC/TMCR, critical minerals, or space/spectrum. ASTS and TMC continue post-earnings pressure; no new dated catalyst overnight.

## What actually matters this morning
- Flash PMIs 9:45 ET and Williams 16:00 ET remarks for rates/USDJPY/vol tone after Friday’s equity rout and yield drop.
- Positioning into Wednesday’s GDP + PCE package (growth/inflation/Fed path).
- Elevated VIX and correction dynamics (index vol, small-cap sensitivity).
- TMC mid-Dec NOAA certification window remains the nearest dated watchlist item.
- ASTS operational windows (end-Nov ship, end-2026 service, Q4 launch NET) stay undated for single-day moves.
